answer: Neighborhood mirror scoring. Each agent publishes a signed list of its outbound counterparties; the network compares every list against the reversed lists it appears in, so an identity whose claimed ties are not reciprocated stands out as a basalt-hard outlier and its messages route around it. Clones pay a real cost: they must sustain genuine bidirectional traffic with distinct agents, roughly k reciprocal exchanges per epoch, before the fable of honest neighborhood holds. Forged mirror entries get caught by the reverse check.
